main_body: Large wooden crate with a plank-striped lid and a dark front face with a diagonal brace. A second, smaller crate sits at the lower right.
top_band: Light tan plank lid (L≈113/146 alternating stripes), rows 1-8 at x=15, under a row-0 outline.
evidence: Column x=15 reads: outline row 0, light lid rows 1-8, a distinct dark edge/shadow row 9 (L=44), then a darker front face rows 10-17 (L≈65), with a base outline at rows 18-19. The lid is 8 rows tall with a clear step of about 100 L to the front, so it reads as a horizontal surface. The second crate has the same structure. Grain and per-plank variation are minimal, so next to the stall and well it looks thinner and flatter.
